# Federated Frontier Intelligence — Copilot instructions

This documentation-first repository specifies a research program for federated frontier-scale AI. Read root `AGENTS.md`; it is the shared operating contract for Copilot, Codex, Grok, humans, and future agents.

Before changing a file, follow the source-of-truth order in `AGENTS.md`. Use accepted ADRs and normative requirements over summaries. Complex implementation work starts from an approved ExecPlan in `docs/exec-plans/active/`.

For research changes, prefer primary sources, classify material claims E0–E4, record experimental scale and limitations, and update the bibliography, evidence matrix, and traceability matrix together. For architecture changes, add stable requirement IDs and an ADR when the decision is durable. Keep unsupported choices Proposed or Experimental.

Validate links, identifiers, traceability, Mermaid, citations, secrets, and changed documentation. Report exact validation performed. Never invent results, commands, citations, or security properties.

Implementation code has no accepted language or framework baseline yet. Follow the relevant ADR and ExecPlan once selected; avoid introducing a framework through incidental work.
